headline: Cloudflare rolls out AI agent infrastructure tools; Yelp deepens ChatGPT integration — AI search distribution accelerates

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Cloudflare launches AI agent security and connectivity suite during #AgentsWeek | Cloudflare推出AI代理安全与连接套件
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: AI爬虫和agentic traffic的基础设施正在快速成型，Cloudflare作为CDN/安全层的关键角色，其工具将直接影响网站如何控制、监控和优化来自AI代理的流量。对GEO策略有结构性影响。
AI Search / GEO.evidence: Cloudflare official X account announcing #AgentsWeek recap covering Wallets, Radar, and workforce/infrastructure protection for AI agents
AI Search / GEO.evidence_detail: Cloudflare's #AgentsWeek (concluded 2025-06-19) included multiple product announcements: AI agent wallet/payment infrastructure, Radar analytics for AI traffic patterns, and workforce/infrastructure protection tools. The announcements are high-level recap posts without technical specifications or pricing details. No third-party validation or deployment data available yet.
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: 评估当前robots.txt和Cloudflare防火墙规则对AI爬虫的覆盖 | 关注Cloudflare Radar AI流量报告的数据发布

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Yelp integrates Reservations and Waitlist directly into ChatGPT | Yelp将预订和排队功能接入ChatGPT
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: 这是本地服务GEO（Generative Engine Optimization）的关键案例：ChatGPT正在成为本地搜索的交易层，而非仅信息层。对本地SEO/GEO策略有直接影响，第三方平台在AI搜索中的权重分配正在变化。
AI Search / GEO.evidence: glenngabe observation of Yelp's ChatGPT integration for table booking and waitlist functionality
AI Search / GEO.evidence_detail: Glenn Gabe (data researcher tracking algorithm changes and platform moves) reported on Yelp's expansion into ChatGPT with transactional capabilities. This follows Yelp's earlier AI search integrations. No quantitative data on adoption or traffic impact provided. The integration appears to be US-market focused initially.
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: 监控Yelp商家后台的AI来源数据 | 评估餐厅/服务类客户的ChatGPT可见性优化

Playbook: Worth Testing.what_happened: Third-party AI citations reinforce need for combined social media and digital PR strategy | 第三方AI引用强化社媒+数字PR组合策略
Playbook: Worth Testing.why_it_matters: Aleyda指出AI引用中第三方来源的权重分布，说明GEO不能只依赖单一渠道。社媒信号和数字PR在AI搜索中的相对重要性正在重新平衡，需要整合策略。
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence: aleyda analysis of AI citation patterns showing social media and digital PR both required with shifting relative importance
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence_detail: Aleyda Solis (international SEO expert, no commercial interest stated) analyzed AI citation patterns and concluded that both social media and digital PR are necessary, though their relative importance varies. No specific data set, methodology, or platform breakdown was provided in the source text. This is expert interpretation rather than controlled experiment.
Playbook: Worth Testing.what_to_do: 审计现有AI引用来源分布 | 测试社媒内容对Perplexity/ChatGPT引用的影响
Playbook: Worth Testing.how_to_test: 选择5-10个已获AI引用的页面，在LinkedIn/Twitter发布带原始数据图表的摘要，30天后对比AI引用来源中社媒占比变化
Playbook: Worth Testing.success_metric: AI引用中社媒来源占比提升；品牌查询的AI Overview出现率
Playbook: Worth Testing.effort: 低至中等工作量；风险为社媒内容可能分散SEO资源
